name: Clerky
description:
Bring your cap table data from Clerky into the conversation. Visualize ownership, model exits, and get instant answers without searching through paperwork. You can even combine your cap table data with your startup’s other tools. Just connect your Clerky account and choose which teams Claude can access to get started.

This connection is read-only. Claude can only retrieve information for teams you authorize and can’t start document sets or modify anything. Access runs through OAuth and can be disconnected at any time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Clerky to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Clerky to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.clerky.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Clerky MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clerky provides these MCP tools: get_team_cap_table and list_teams.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Clerky?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Clerky in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Clerky requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Clerky is developed by Clerky. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
